messages:
jordan_csm: Heads-up: SkyPort token volume dropped ~70% in the last 10 days after our champion left. procurement started a short eval with NimbusAI. marking renewal-risk, need quick triage :warning:
lee_sales: Noted. Who's the new contact and any sign they're migrating for cost reasons or features? :eyes:
jordan_csm: New ML lead in CRM is Aaron K. Procurement mentioned lower-cost throughput is their priority.
maya_cs: I'll reach out. proposed play: 1) 20m enablement with new lead + procurement, 2) short tech pre-read + prompt sample request, 3) offer a small promo credit for a 1-week Dedicated canary if they commit to enablement.
hugo_eng: Checking infra now. no model regressions, but auth logs show increased 403s and a drop in background job runs. runbook issue likely. Quick query:
 huguo_query: ```sql
SELECT day, jobs_run, tokens_generated FROM account_usage
WHERE account_id='skyport' AND day >= current_date - interval '14 days'
ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 14;
```
queue_bot: Snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/skyport/usage (14d: -70% tokens, seats 8 -> 3) :bar_chart:
lee_sales: I'll greenlight promo credit up to $4k as credits if CS secures enablement + exec sync. legal prefers credits.
maya_cs: Sending diagnostic request to Aaron now and proposing Tue/Wed 20m slots. asking them to paste top 5 prompts and run this quick check:
```bash
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/skyport/diagnostic \\
  -d '{"sample_days":7, "check_triggers": true}'
```
jordan_csm: Good. Maya, can you also confirm if any cron hooks or automation runners were disabled after the handover? If it's workflow-disable, enablement + runbook will likely recover ~50% of volume quickly.
maya_cs: Asked Aaron to confirm cron jobs. meeting tentatively Wed 10:00. will update with customer notes and diagnostic output.
jordan_csm: Plan summary: outreach owner = maya_cs, eng pre-read = hugo_eng, commercial = lee_sales. Target: enablement + exec sync this week, then re-evaluate renewal risk. :rocket:
